mission: Unblock collector releases (#197) after Railway stopped offering redeployable copies of collector images (canRedeploy false since 2026-10-22). Owner decision 2026-10-24 17:26 MYT, pragmatist: the rollout preflight records rollback mode 'redeploy' (exact image, unchanged) or 'reupload' (the active commit, required in the full-history checkout, uploaded again from a detached worktree with the release markers and exact-commit message, followed to SUCCESS, then checked active, SUCCESS, exact marker, unchanged schedule, start command and writer flags). Neither: refuse before any upload. Only the 'no redeployable copy' error switches modes; provider errors refuse. Receipt records the mode. Independent review: FAIL then PASS after fixes.

impacts.reason: capture_before: rollback mode redeploy/reupload (has_commit), refuse when neither; roll_back dispatches per mode; reupload() (worktree, markers, railway up with exact-commit message, new_upload excludes pre-existing deployment ids, SKIPPED only for 'No changes to watched files'), verify_reupload() (active, SUCCESS, marker, schedule, start command, writer flags); build_markers(root); receipt before.<collector>.rollback. Forward release path unchanged.

Fallback to reupload and its receipt mode, refusal without commit, provider errors refuse, worktree upload with markers and message, cleanup and prune on failure, skip handling, inactive previous deployment refused, mixed modes with one failure continuing, message parity with collector_variables.
Collector rollback without a redeployable image: modes, owner decision, manual Railway rollback caveat (restores old variables).

resources: staging-automerge collector rollout (all 10 collectors) and its rollback
routes: railway up from a detached worktree of the previous verified commit, only on rollback
dependencies: full-history checkout in staging-automerge and staging-delivery (fetch-depth: 0)
impact.deployment_impact: Merging changes nothing live. The next collector release (#197 re-release) uses it; a rollback, if needed, rebuilds the previous commit instead of redeploying its image.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file; collector releases then refuse again until Railway offers redeployable copies.
recovery.trigger: A rollback reports success while a collector is not on its previous commit, or a re-upload deploys the wrong commit.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: The #197 re-release receipt (before.*.rollback = reupload) and its delivery verify.
